events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; ls ~/tantra-onboarding-v2/cloud 2>&1 | head -40; lsof -iTCP:8790 -sTCP:LISTEN 2>&1 | head; grep -rnE "ai[-_/]?connections|last_error|model_map|task_models|modelPerTask" ~/tantra-onboarding-v2/cloud/src --include=*.ts -l 2>/dev/null | head -20

events.text:
T-292 is in review: the local centre has Opus (connection 1) on for real drafts and connection 3 as the probe fallback (person draft logged `claude-opus-5-5`, probe draft `claude-sonnet-5-5`), and the live Worker has no AI connections at all, so I left it alone and recorded that.

- **Local state:** it was already in the target state when I checked, so I changed no settings. Model per task needed no change because the code already sends probe drafts to the non-Opus connection first.
- **Test attendee:** the two verification drafts ran on a new test attendee I created in the local centre (id 419, "T-292 Model Check"), which is still there.
- **Live Worker:** real attendees there get no AI drafts until Adi adds an Anthropic API key in the live admin's AI connections tab. That is the one input in `needs_from_owner`.
- **Housekeeping:** F-13bc4293 was already acknowledged, reviewers are now Adi and Nelbin, and the task file is committed as `3305efe`.
